description: Data Protected Bike Lanes, Oct 2019 is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by BikePGH. On Wednesday, October 16, BikePGH, in collaboration with the How’s My Driving app, rallied nearly 70 volunteers to disperse along select Pittsburgh bike lanes to count the number of times vehicles were parking, standing, or loading in the bike-only lanes. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher BikePGH. Its tags are bicycle, bike, bike infrastructure, bike lane, bike lanes. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2023-05-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
